what: Verification that work/j1_model/ (the exp9 distilled J1 judge, ~1.1 GB) is genuinely regenerable, so it can be removed from the published repository without losing anything.
why_removed: GitHub deployment rejects files of 100 MB or more. The directory is a REASSEMBLED COPY of the exp9 artifact's judge_model/mdeberta_gemini_distill/model_parts/ shards, which are published with THAT artifact. Its only output, work/ttj_j1_labels.jsonl (12,200 labels, 1.7 MB), is shipped here, so the translate-then-judge arm reproduces without the weights.
restore_command: ./restore.sh   (or: cd src && ../.venv/bin/python -c "import ttj_judge_j1 as t; t.ensure_model()")

test_1_reassembly.note: src/ttj_judge_j1.py ensure_model() concatenates the shards and refuses to return a checkpoint whose sha256 does not match exp9's manifest

test_2_replay.design: class-balanced sample of rows the ORIGINAL run had already labelled, re-predicted through the freshly restored tokenizer+model
test_2_replay.note: a first attempt used the first 8 rows, which were all REFUSE; that test would have passed for a constant predictor, so it was replaced by this class-balanced one

downstream_dependency: src/readout.py reads work/ttj_j1_labels.jsonl only; no analysis code loads the weights
